en: Kiryu-san, what exactly do you see me as?

Well, I can't deny it would be
pretty great living together with you.

That does make me happy.
But, you should make me your wife, then.
Yeah, good point...
Today's been fun. Thanks.

No, I should be thanking you. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
By the way, I have a proposal...

Um, are you free after this?
I was wondering if you'd like to go on a date.

I don't mind.
You're good to go?

Of course! I'd follow you to the
ends of the Earth! All right! It's a promise!

You okay with meeting in
front of the Millennium Tower?
I'll text you later.
Yeah. See you soon.
Okay! Oh, I can't wait!

My hobbies?
Maybeee... fantasizing?
F-Fantasizing?

Yeah. I fantasize all the time! You know, like,
"What would it be like to date that guy?"

Then, I write it all down in a notebook so
I can come back to it if I want to.

Sounds like a good read.
Can I see the notebook?

Whaaaat!? No way!
I'd just die!
Aww, why not?

Hmmm... Fine, how 'bout I choose some fantasies
I'm okay with sharing and you can see those?

It'd be too embarrassing to show
you the low quality ones.

S-Sure...
The mind of a pro is something else...
You're not fantasizing about me, are you?

Doesn't being told not to do something just make
you want to do it more? What should I picture?

Think you could fit me
into one of your fantasies?

Sure! Kiryu-san...
Hmm, let's see here...

Kiryu-san is actually a firefighter...
And after we start dating, there's a fire...

So he comes to save me, but...
Naaaw, this is getting too clichéd.

I let myself get some sleep on my days off!
And maybe fit in some online shopping?

My job takes a lot out of me physically, so on
my days off, I just want to veg.

Not too long, actually.
There's still a lot I'm not used to.

I want to pick up the pace a little
and figure out how to be a little more girly.
Based on the slight accent... Kyoto?

Wow, good guess, Kiryu-san!
I <font_kind=yakuza_italic>am</font_kind> from Kyoto.

Monkfish liver, I guess.
Anything that goes down well with booze.

I'm glad you asked!
I like my men like I like my gorillas!
G-Gorillas?
You mean, manly and rugged like a gorilla?

Exactly, rugged is a good word for it.
And gorillas have the kindest faces, right?

A gorilla, huh?
So, someone like me?

You <font_kind=yakuza_italic>may</font_kind> be just rugged enough
to qualify as a gorilla, Kiryu-san!

But you're like... a pure, refined,
urban gorilla, or something. In a good way?

An urban gorilla...
I don't know how to feel about that.
Ook ook...

Never mind.
Forget I ever did that.

But that was pretty funny, Kiryu-san!
You're a riot!

When I fall in love, I want to do anything I can
for that person. I'd even cook for him every day.

But when I say that kind of stuff, people tell
me it's kind of out of character for me.

I don't think that's true. On the inside,
maybe you're girlier than you think.

Huh? You think so? You're the only person
who's ever told me that. I'm all happy now.

As a pro wrestler, only being the best.
In my private life, getting married, I guess?

You wouldn't know to look at me, but I'm a great
cook, and I'd be such a devoted, great wife to my husband!
You're sure of yourself, huh?

Sometimes you've gotta make a case for yourself,
y'know? You mull it over, Kiryu-san. Sound good?

My parents were both into martial arts,
so I always dreamed of being some kind of fighter.

Honestly though, I never thought I'd become a pro
wrestler. Life has a strange way of working out.

Special skills?
Hmmmmm.... I s'pose I'm a pretty good cook.

Other than that...
high kicks and sleeper holds?
Those are more techniques than skills...

True! Oh, speaking of special techniques,
I have a few original ones, you know.
Yeah? What are they called?

Oh, whatever could they be?
Here's a hint: "Blank Galaxy."

Salaryman Galaxy!
Is that right?

Huh!? How did you know!? That's amazing!
Are you a mind-reader?
Nah, but maybe I'd heard it somewhere.

Whoa. Does that mean I'm actually getting famous?
That's the best news! <symbol=note_with_outline>

Lover Love Galaxy!
Is that right?

Bzzzt!
The right answer was "Salaryman Galaxy"!
How was I supposed to guess that...?

But "Lover Love Galaxy" is kind of cute.
Maybe that's what I'll call my next one...

Nah, it's too embarrassing.
Forget it...

Cinderella Galaxy!
Is that right?

Whoa! Isn't that some old song? And it's wrong,
anyway! The right answer was "Salaryman Galaxy"!
I never would have gotten that...

Something interesting...
Hmmm... Meeting you, Kiryu-san?
Am I that interesting?

Kiryu-san, you're super interesting.
Maybe you just don't know it?

Not too many.
I have a few good friends, though.

Huh, I see.
You seem like the type to have a lot.

You know how girls tend to hang out in packs?
I've never really liked that.

Maybe that part of me's kinda boyish.
But once I fall in love, I'm all woman. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Makes sense. I think guys tend
to like dating girls like that.

That's good. Pro wrestling is dominated by men.
Maybe that's a good fit for me, in that sense.

I totally suck at games. But I like watching
sometimes. I'd watch you play, Kiryu-san.

Hm? What's this then?
What are these deep, dark secrets?

I was actually a wrestler myself at one
time called "Dragon Mask."
What!? Are you serious?
I only did it to entertain some kids, though.

It's actually kind of hard to have a serious
fight while trying to entertain an audience.

Yeah. You can't be just strong. You have to
fight in a way the audience wants to watch.

It made me realize how deep pro wrestling is.
In fact, I found a new respect for pros like you.

Kiryu-san... Thank you.
You're too nice to me.

Huh!? You have a tattoo, Kiryu-san!?
I wanna see! Tear your shirt off, right now!
U-Uh... I can't do that in here...
Alcohol? I love a good drink!

As favorites go, it's shochu and sake...
But pretty much anything goes!
Then we should drink the place dry.

Totally! Let's really crank up the fun.
Besides, if sales go up, so does my rank!
You're pretty clever.

I'm just joking.
But I'm plenty serious about the fun part. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Wow. It's unusual for someone your age to get
into the hard liquor.

I know, right? But I like how they're meant to
be savored, and they go great with snacks.

You know the right way to enjoy a drink.
And I'll drink to that.

Oh, sounds good!
I'll join you!
Nice, then... I'll have a water!
What the<symbol=em_dash_with_outline> You can't just do that!
I'm joking.

Oh, Kiryu-san's apparently a comedian...
You're real funny...

The Tojo... Clan?
Wasn't that the name of a pro wrestling team?

No, it's not a wrestling team... Though they
sure do get into about as many brawls...

Oh, I know her!
She was on TV a while back, right?

If I recall, she did a concert with another
group called T-Back...
...Pretty sure it was T-Set.

Oh man, I'd love to hear about
your crazy adventures, Kiryu-san!

They weren't that crazy...
And they'll take a while to explain...

Oh, long story?
That's okay, forget it then!
Hey now...

I'm sure I don't look the part, but I cook a lot.
I'm pretty good at making stews.
I'm good at stuff like stews and hot pots.

Those sound great. Now that I think about it,
I haven't had hot pot in a long time.

Yeah, it's not a one-person meal.
Wanna come over and share some?
You wouldn't mind?

Course not! It'd be awesome
to share a hot pot with you! <symbol=heart_with_outline>
What type do you think I am?
Type A!
Oh, good guess!
Type B!
Nope. I'm a type A!
Either AB or O.

Hey, c'mon now, Kiryu-san! No fair!
They're both wrong anyway!

You really want to know?
Well I'm not telling, mister pervert.
Nope! This is your chance, Kiryu-san!

A lot of reasons really, but the biggest one
has to do with overcoming my complex.
Complex?

Between my personality and being a pro wrestler,
I don't get treated like a girl very often.
And part of me's not okay with that...
That makes sense.

So I thought maybe working as a hostess would
help me figure out how to be more feminine.

It's certainly true that femininity is how you
get ahead in a cabaret club. It's the right idea.

Yeah, I'm going to keep trying to work
on being more of a girly girl.

Well, if you ask me, I think you're feminine
enough as you are. I only see you as a woman.

Kiryu-san...! Thank you so much! Keep smooth
talkin' me like that and I might fall for you.

Whoa, Kiryu-san! That's a new one.
You're a funny guy.
I'm so not playing the king game, though.

Hmm... These days I've been listening to a lot
of love songs and music aimed at girls.
Huh, that's different.

I may not have the look, but I'm pretty girly
on the inside. Cute, right?
It's fun talking with you too, Kiryu-san.

Agreed... If I get sick from not dressing warm
enough, I won't be able to wrestle.
Yeah... Try not to catch a cold, Kiryu-san.

Okay, how about I warm you up a bit?
Joking. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Nice! That makes me really happy to hear.
Let's throw a few more back!
Wow, thank you so much!

Wait, what!? You're just gonna confess to me
out of the blue? I wasn't ready for that...
I was kidding.
Oh, you're terrible!

Yaaaaaaaay!
This is so fun.
Hi! How ya doin'?
Great, thanks to you.

Huh? Wait, just out of the blue like that!?
Are you serious, Kiryu-san?
Yeah. I'm very serious.

I've never had anyone ask me
to let them touch me so seriously like that!
Yes! You're a weird one, Kiryu-san.
I'm not serious.

You're such a funny guy!
Well, either way, no touching!
It's an American joke!

That's not an American joke at all!
Kiryu-san... You're so funny.
(Wait... I can't get a read on her...)

I'm so happy to hear that.
Oh no, I'm seein' hearts...
Oh, I'm not, really!

Wow! Kiryu-san, you're fluent in English!
Good English!

Only you?
Hm, what should I do?

Hey... You should only look
at me too, okay?
Huh? That's a secret. <symbol=note_with_outline>

You want me to tell you?
Hm, should I? <symbol=note_with_outline>
Is there anyone you like?

Oh, don't make me say it!
Of course there is... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Really?
Maybe I'll see what happens... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Thank you. The owners are really good people,
so it's a nice place to work.

And they're really open-minded to actually hire
a pro wrestler like me.

I'd say they're good at their jobs to hire
a girl like you.

Too smooth, Kiryu-san!
You make me feel like I can do anything! <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I don't know too many, actually.
But I'm eager to try some new ones.

You go to places like that...? Oh no,
I'm starting to imagine it! Let's change subjects!

Huh!? You wrecked a convenience store?
You sure you don't wanna be a pro wrestler?
Hmm, well, it wasn't intentional...

Destroying a convenience store... Actually,
a convenience store death match could totally work!
That's a great idea! Thank you!
Whoa! Pulling out the heavy topics!

Memories of someone who's passed on, huh? You
can't help but think about it sometimes.

Maybe it's not my place to say, but, I think
you've got to work hard for his sake, too.

True enough.
I think that's the right attitude.
Yeah. I'm glad we got to talk about this.

A true friend, huh? That's someone you can say
whatever you really feel without holding back, I guess.

Speaking of friends...
do you think men and women can be just friends?

Why not?
I have some friends where gender means nothing.

Exactly, right!?
I have a lot of guy friends!

You're probably the type of person
guys find easy to talk to.

You think so?
People are always saying I'm so manly, though.

I don't think so.
A guy always has ulterior motives.

What? You think so? I've got a lot of guy friends,
so that's making me wonder.

I think they can, but...
I couldn't make that work with you.

Huh!? Why not!?
Did I say something that got under your skin?

No, I just mean I see you more
as a woman than a friend.

K-Kiryu-san...! Seriously,
do you always have to be so cool?

Whew... I haven't felt a rush
like that in a while.
Mission accomplished.

Really!? You <font_kind=yakuza_italic>do</font_kind> seem like you'd spoil them.
You're really kind.

Maybe if I were just a baby,
you'd be nicer to me!
Hey, I'm plenty nice now, aren't I?
You fish, Kiryu-san?
Yeah, I've been spearfishing lately.

That's so cool! I bet the fish
you catch would taste amazing!

Wow, so kind of like a war between two teams?
This sounds like a pro wrestling storyline.
